svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 07 · Riverside · 10/12 The Packing House (Common)
svg.desc: Oranges once left town in wooden crates, each one with a bright painted label on the end. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
